messages:
Morgan: Quick sync — consolidating postmortem follow-ups from yesterday's DR incident. I want a single prioritized list of remediations, owners, and timelines. Share short status updates.
Tanya: I'll own multi-region routing playbook updates. ETA end of week. I'll add a step-by-step checklist to the runbook: `runbooks/dr-routing.md` and include canary steps.
Samir: I'll take backups + restore validation matrix. Planning a focused restore test during next game day. @ops-bot can you schedule the rehearsal for Tue next week?
ops-bot: Scheduled: "Restore game day rehearsal" on 2026-03-17 18:00 UTC. Reminder created and invites sent to participants.
Leo: Noted a recurring pattern: routing flaps under sustained cross-region traffic >4k rps. Mitigation proposals: prefix/KV cache + a lightweight fallback route. Will pair with Tanya for canary.
Tanya: Agree. Adding `region_fallback=true` config and a canary flag. PR coming for staging; will document rollback steps.
Morgan: Please make acceptance criteria explicit and include one rollback plan per item. Also estimate SLO impact in the action card.
Samir: Acceptance criteria: single-region restore <30m, cross-region restore <45m. Rollback: shift traffic to warm-standby within 5m. Docs ETA: 2026-03-12, test run ETA: 2026-03-17.
Leo: I'll own traffic-shaping in the LB layer; pairing with infra. ETA 2026-03-15. Will add monitoring alerts for queue depth.
Tanya: Created task cards and assigned owners on the DR board: https://board.redwood.example/board/DR. PR #2124 for canary config in staging.
Morgan: Great. I'll take these into the next game-day retro. @Samir @Tanya ensure runbook headers include owners & contact info (pager/team).
Samir: :thumbsup: Added owners to runbook and logged the pattern in incident tracker under tag `recurring-routing`. Proposal: monthly dry-run rotation for routing tests.
ops-bot: Reminder: created recurring event "Monthly DR drill" starting 2026-04-02 09:00 UTC. First invite sent.
Leo: One more thing — we need read-only k8s creds for runbook runners. @PeopleOps can you expedite access approvals?
PeopleOps: Looping in security. Please file a ticket with required scopes and list of runner service accounts.
Morgan: Thanks everyone. I'll publish the consolidated action tracker by EOD and post an owners-summary in #eng-sre. Short follow-ups only in this thread.
